I don't know of any such flag. As far as I know, `ollama pull` has no CLI option for setting the number of parallel layer downloads. The flags I'm aware of are things like `--insecure` (allow insecure registry connections), and the download concurrency is handled internally by Ollama rather than being user-configurable from the command line.
